cases.title: uses the configured default when a legacy caller omits streamFn
cases.assertion_scope: Reflect.apply省略streamFn；仅断言fallback被调用一次，finally恢复全局注册

cases.title: should emit events with AgentMessage types
cases.assertion_scope: user+assistant两条结果与生命周期事件存在；不是精确全序断言

cases.title: should handle custom message types via convertToLlm
cases.assertion_scope: 过滤notification后仅user传给转换结果；不验证真实provider角色规则

cases.title: should apply transformContext before convertToLlm
cases.assertion_scope: 转换前后数组长度均2，原context五条；只覆盖裁剪接线，不覆盖异步竞态

cases.title: should handle tool calls and results
cases.assertion_scope: echo回调实执行hello，start/end成功；after hook usage替换进入toolResult

cases.title: should not execute tool calls from a length-truncated assistant message
cases.assertion_scope: 单个length工具零回调、错误含output token limit，第二次模型调用允许恢复

cases.title: should execute mutated beforeToolCall args without revalidation
cases.assertion_scope: schema string参数经before hook变123，execute实际收到123；刻意证明不二次校验

cases.title: should prepare tool arguments for validation
cases.assertion_scope: oldText/newText改写edits后真实TypeBox校验，回调接收一组替换

cases.title: should emit tool_execution_end in completion order but persist tool results in source order
cases.assertion_scope: Promise+20ms gate观察回调重叠，end=2,1，而message_end和turn_end结果=1,2

cases.title: should inject queued messages after all tool calls complete
cases.assertion_scope: 串行两回调和两result均先于interrupt，下一stream context含interrupt

cases.title: should force sequential execution when a tool has executionMode=sequential even with default parallel config
cases.assertion_scope: 单个sequential工具被调用两次，parallelObserved=false且结果源序

cases.title: should force sequential execution when one of multiple tools has executionMode=sequential
cases.assertion_scope: 弱断言：executionOrder首项slow且包含fast；未直接断言fast晚于slow完成

cases.title: should allow parallel execution when all tools have executionMode=parallel
cases.assertion_scope: 全parallel工具两次调用，第一未完成时第二可执行，parallelObserved=true

cases.title: should use prepareNextTurn snapshot before continuing
cases.assertion_scope: 只验证systemPrompt替换、prepare一次、stream两次；无长prepare新steer/去重断言

cases.title: should stop after the current turn when shouldStopAfterTurn returns true
cases.assertion_scope: 一次stream/echo，steer只初poll一次、followUp零次；callback context和完整事件全序

cases.title: should stop after a tool batch when every tool result sets terminate=true
cases.assertion_scope: 仅一个工具terminate=true，stream一次、一次turn_end；不独立证明多工具every谓词

cases.title: should stop after a blocked tool call when beforeToolCall sets terminate=true
cases.assertion_scope: 单工具不执行、stream一次，错误toolResult含Blocked by policy

cases.title: should continue after a mixed batch with one terminating blocked call
cases.assertion_scope: first被block/terminate，second实际echo，stream两次

cases.title: should continue after parallel tool calls when not all tool results terminate
cases.assertion_scope: 两个回调仅first terminate，stream两次且结果角色序含两toolResult

cases.title: should allow afterToolCall to mark a tool batch as terminating
cases.assertion_scope: 单工具after hook terminate导致stream一次；非多工具全批证据

cases.title: should throw when context has no messages
cases.assertion_scope: 空context同步抛错，stream不得被调用

cases.title: should continue from existing context without emitting user message events
cases.assertion_scope: 已有user不重发，只有新assistant结果及message_end

cases.title: should allow custom message types as last message (caller responsibility)
cases.assertion_scope: custom尾部由fixture转换成user，返回一assistant；不是实际provider请求
